title: The Evolution and Expression of the Moth Visual Opsin Family
why: Loxostege, lambda_max_nm and spectral_range_nm: the stored abstract says that long-wavelength, blue and ultraviolet opsin genes were cloned from 12 species of wild-captured moths and their expression studied (dark treatment in Helicoverpa armigera); the harvest returned it for "Loxostege vision", "Loxostege eye" and "Loxostege spectral sensitivity opsin", so the beet webworm is probably one of the 12, and the paper may give its opsin complement and so its likely pigment classes.
